method: Independent 1:1 visual inspection of four 1486x1059 PNGs, with boundary pixels sampled from source images; coordinates are approximate to 2 px
matching_content: Six project names, three status labels and colors, two text project tabs, expanded Status property and README.md file tree appear in both pairs
remaining_visible_differences: Mock Board orders Planned, In Progress, Done; final renderer orders Done, In Progress, Planned. Final map attributes order to discovery/status semantics.
Mock active Board/project tabs have a purple bottom underline; final renderer uses lavender rounded active pills without underline. This is not explained in final-deviation-map.md.
Mock sidebar and Board columns use subtle gradients and strokes; final renderer uses almost flat light surfaces. This is not explained in final-deviation-map.md.
Mock toolbar includes a separate ellipsis and different Customize glyph; final renderer has Add View and Customize only. Final map identifies ellipsis as illustration-only command.
Renderer PNGs omit macOS traffic lights/rounded native frame. This is correctly labelled as a CDP renderer boundary and needs full-window capture for acceptance.
responsive_1440_observation: native-final-board-1440x960.png has a partially visible project detail panel covering approximately x1345–1440. Its capture command waits only for Board aria-selected=true, not panel transition completion; this file cannot establish settled unobstructed Board layout at 1440x960.
responsive_1024_observation: native-final-board-1024x720.png and native-final-expanded-1024x720.png show a single upper row, pinned actions, horizontal Board and tab clipping. Native-focus-1024x720.png shows Add View focus ring. These are renderer surface captures, not macOS full-window captures.
